result.title: Temporal Logic Tensor Networks: Foundations of Temporal Reasoning in Neural Networks
result.summary: In dynamic scenes---football matches, traffic streams, surgery, or assembly---actions unfold at fundamentally different time scales: in football, a kick happens in milliseconds, a possession lasts seconds, and complex events such as a successful pass followed by a goal combine multiple atomic actions over extended durations. Models trained solely on visual data struggle to learn effectively across different time scales, lacking a principled way of reasoning across fine-grained instants and broader intervals. Neither point-wise nor purely interval semantics suffices: the former fragments events into frame-level snapshots lacking overall event identification; the latter treats intervals as atomic truth-values, ignoring state trajectories. We introduce Temporal Logic Tensor Networks (tLTN), a differentiable neuro-symbolic framework addressing this duality via a formal, multi-sorted logic where events and states are structurally interdependent. Extending Interval Logic Tensor Networks (ILTN), tLTN grounds state predicates as fuzzy truth-value paths over time points, while events are first-class entities with learnable trapezoidal fuzzy durations and differentiable Allen-style relations. A compositional semantics fuses static, event-structural, and state-dynamic satisfaction into a single differentiable LTN grounding. Crucially, the modalities constrain each other bidirectionally: the interval layer dictates where point-wise constraints (e.g., Until, Since) are evaluated, restricting them to event-defined spans; conversely, the point-wise layer validates interval relations, rejecting them if underlying state dynamics contradict the relation. Through controlled synthetic examples, we show when single-modality learning fails and how this localization reduces frame-level computational cost on long traces.

AI.brief_summary: 提出可微神经符号框架 tLTN，用多类逻辑把事件（可学习梯形模糊时长、可微 Allen 关系）与状态（时间点上的模糊真值路径）结构性地联结，并将静态、事件结构与状态动态三类满足性合成为单一可微接地；在合成场景中展示单模态学习失效的情形及事件区间定位对长轨迹计算量的削减。
AI.relevance_reason: 其事件—状态双向约束与可微时序接地，可能为 VLM 中对 latent 中间状态与证据区间施加结构化监督、并按事件跨度局部化计算提供线索，尚待核查能否用于 latent 推理轨迹而非仅符号约束。
